no_dice_rule: For a fixed input script and a fixed initial state, the set of (frame, attacker, target, hurtbox, damage) tuples is BIT-IDENTICAL across every RNG seed and every run. No call to any random source occurs on the hit-resolution path. ARBITRATION S1: Morrowind's to-hit roll is deleted. There is no miss chance, no evasion stat, no damage variance, no critical-hit chance, no glancing blow.

step_order._source: RI-CMB04 §A — BINDING. Steps may not be reordered, merged, or moved to the render loop.
step_order.1: sample input            -> latch button/stick state for this frame
step_order.2: advance state machine   -> resolve buffered inputs, transitions, stamina spends
step_order.4: evaluate skeleton       -> world matrices for every bone, from the clip at anim_frame
step_order.5: consume root motion     -> apply clip root delta to controller, resolve collision
step_order.6: rebuild hurtboxes       -> transform each hurtbox capsule from its parent bone
step_order.7: set hitbox active flags -> from frames.json at this anim_frame
step_order.8: sweep + query           -> continuous overlap tests, this frame's pose vs last frame's
step_order.9: resolve                 -> i-frames, block cone, dedup, poise, damage, events
step_order._why_4_then_6: Hurtboxes are DERIVED from the animated pose, every frame, AFTER the animation has been evaluated. A hurtbox that is a static capsule at the character's root is not a hurtbox.

weapon_hitboxes._why_sweeping_is_mandatory: Every weapon travels 2.5x to 4x its own capsule radius in a single 60 Hz frame at peak swing speed. Discrete per-frame overlap tests would miss a stationary target for most of the arc.

sweep.substeps_are_not_a_quality_setting: Reducing them to 1 changes which attacks connect, which changes the game. Never wire this to a graphics option.

interpolation.why: linear rotation lerp on a fast arc under-covers the swept region

sweep.first_active_frame_prev_pose: the pose on frame first_active - 1, so the sweep starts from BEFORE the hitbox turns on and the leading edge is covered
sweep.broadphase: AABB of the swept hull, expanded by 0.05 m
sweep.swept_volume: convex_hull_of_capsules(capsule(A0,B0,r), capsule(A1,B1,r)) = Minkowski sum of hull{A0,B0,A1,B1} with a sphere of radius r. Overlap with a target capsule(P,Q,rt) <=> dist(hull{A0,B0,A1,B1}, segment(P,Q)) <= r + rt. Computed in closed form (segment-vs-tetrahedron), not by iteration.

hurtboxes._source: RI-CMB04 §D — eleven capsules per humanoid, each parented to a bone, rebuilt at step 6 every frame.
hurtboxes._count_note: RI-CMB04 §D says 'eleven capsules' and then tabulates eight rows of which four are l/r pairs — 4 singles + 4 pairs = 12 capsules. This build ships the TWELVE the table enumerates rather than dropping one to hit the prose count, and says so. The count is prose; the table is the artifact.
rules: Capsules follow bones, INCLUDING during hitstun, rolls and death. A rolling player's capsules are low and forward, which is why a high arc can pass over a roll even OUTSIDE i-frames. That emergent property is desirable and must survive.
damage_mult is a per-enemy declaration defaulting to 1.00. Weak points live in the enemy statblock, not here. The player has no weak points.
When several hurtboxes on one target are struck by one swing, the highest damage_mult wins and EXACTLY ONE damage event is emitted.
Hurtboxes are never scaled by difficulty, level or distance. No aim assist, no forgiveness radius, no 'you were close enough'.

body_hazard._source: ARBITRATION.md seam ruling S26 (wave 1), which is a POSITIVE REQUIREMENT binding on every attack, player and enemy alike: "an attack's swept volume MUST cover the whole of the attacker's root translation during its active frames — the convex hull of the poses, not a capsule at the destination. An attack that moves the attacker forward and tests only where it ended has a hole behind it exactly as deep as it travelled."
body_hazard._what_the_defect_actually_was: The W1-09 round-2 critic diagnosed the hole as the weapon sweep failing to include the attacker's root delta. Measured frame by frame (tools/harness/cmb-reach.mjs --probe mechanism), that is NOT what happens: CombatBody.evaluateRig() already double-buffers the weapon sockets in WORLD space, root motion is applied to pos[] before the rig is evaluated, and the per-frame swept hull therefore already spans the root delta. The hole is one level up. The champion's chop puts the near end of its weapon capsule 0.95 m in front of its own root at the first active frame and carries the root 0.79 m further forward during the active window, so the blade is ahead of a target standing at 0.8 m for every one of those frames and the attacker walks through the target untouched. The volume the ruling says must be covered — the corridor the ATTACKER'S OWN BODY sweeps — was not tested at all, by anything, on either side of the exchange.
body_hazard.rule: While an attack's hitbox is live AND the attacker's root actually translated on this frame, the attacker's own trunk capsules are swept from their previous world pose to their current world pose and tested against the target's hurtboxes with the identical closed-form segment-vs-hull routine the weapon uses. A hit resolves through the identical order (i-frames, block cone, dedup, poise, damage). Being run over by a lunging champion is a hit.
body_hazard.not_a_distance_check: This is deliberately NOT `if (dist < r) hit()` — RI-CMB04 'How we lose' #1. Three properties keep it honest and all three are measurable: (1) the capsules are the attacker's OWN animated hurtboxes, rebuilt from the pose every frame, so the hazard moves and deforms with the animation and is not a radius; (2) it exists only while `root_delta_this_frame != 0`, so an attack that does not translate has NO body hazard and therefore no proximity component whatsoever; (3) it is a SWEPT corridor between two poses, so it covers where the attacker went and not where it is.
body_hazard._why_trunk_only: The ruling says root TRANSLATION. The trunk is the column that carries the root. Sweeping arms and shins as well would widen the hazard past what the ruling asks for and would start hitting people the attacker merely brushed.
body_hazard.damage_mult_source: the TARGET's struck hurtbox, exactly as a weapon hit; the attacker's trunk part is recorded in the event as `via` so a trace can tell a shoulder-check from a sword

resolution_order._source: RI-CMB04 §E — stopping at the first that applies
resolution_order.1: target.invulnerable (frame window) -> emit IFRAME_NEGATE. Nothing else happens.
resolution_order.2: target is BLOCK_HOLD AND angle(target.forward, incoming_direction) <= 60 deg AND not unblockable -> emit BLOCK, apply stamina.json block
resolution_order.3: already-hit dedup: (attack_instance_id, target_id) seen -> discard silently
resolution_order.4: apply poise damage; stagger if broken
resolution_order.5: apply damage = motion_value * weapon_ar * hurtbox.damage_mult * (1 - target.absorption[type]) -> emit HIT
